description: Helper utility module for handling OpenAI-specific cost calculations, including prompt caching, token-based costs, per-second costs, and video generation costs.

methods.name: cost_router
methods.description: Determines whether to use cost per token or per second based on call type.

methods.name: cost_per_token
methods.description: Calculates the cost in USD for tokens used in a model's prompt and completion, considering caching and other factors.

methods.name: cost_per_second
methods.description: Calculates the cost in USD based on response duration, either per second or per output.

methods.name: video_generation_cost
methods.description: Calculates the cost in USD for video generation based on duration and model-specific pricing.
